producer_report.summary: The producer self-check no longer sends a report back over a fmt, clippy or full-suite test criterion that the producer marks "left to Athena's checks". Targeted-test and content criteria still go back. The root cause was that the self-check counted criteria only Athena's recorded checks can show as unmet. A criterion is now skipped only when the entry's evidence starts with the marker (case-insensitive) and the criterion text names cargo fmt, cargo clippy or cargo test with no scope flag (-p, --package, --test, --lib, --bin, --doc, --bench, --example). The marker is accepted with either met or unmet status. Left-over criteria reach the verifier as a non-failing "criteria-left-to-athena-checks" entry. verify::judge is untouched, so a failed recorded check still fails the verdict. The producer brief gained the marker constant `LEFT_TO_ATHENA` and a paragraph before the criteria list, plus a test. outputs.rs got a doc comment only, and CHANGELOG.md an Unreleased entry. Fmt, clippy and the full cargo test pass.

checks_run.note: Run after fixing an unused-assignment warning on left_criteria.

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test in crates/athena-core/src/run.rs shows unmet_criteria returns nothing for a report that marks a full-suite criterion (clippy, fmt --check and workspace cargo test) as left to Athena's checks, and still returns a targeted-test criterion that the report omits. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: New test a_full_suite_criterion_left_to_athenas_checks_is_not_sent_back_but_an_omitted_targeted_one_is in run.rs mod left_to_athena_tests passes under cargo test -p athena-core left_to_athena. It also passes in the full cargo test --locked -q run.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows a criterion marked 'left to Athena's checks' that is not an Athena-check criterion (for example a targeted-test or content criterion) is still returned as unmet and sent back. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: Test the_marker_does_not_excuse_other_criteria_or_an_unmarked_unmet_one: a content criterion and a targeted-test criterion, both marked, are returned as unmet, and so is an unmarked full-suite one. left_to_athena lists none of them. It passes. A fourth test, only_unscoped_cargo_checks_count_as_athena_check_criteria, covers the recognizer.

criteria_check.criterion: A test shows the verifier still fails the job when the recorded full-suite check fails, even though the producer left that criterion to Athena's checks. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_failed_recorded_check_still_fails_a_criterion_the_producer_left_to_athena: unmet_criteria is empty, left_to_athena lists the criterion, then verify::judge with a failed CheckRun (exit 101) gives Verdict::Fail with the reason 'check test failed'. It passes.

criteria_check.criterion: The producer brief's criteria_check section in crates/athena-context/src/briefs.rs tells the producer to mark a criterion that only Athena's recorded checks (fmt, clippy, the full test suite) can show as left to Athena's checks, with the exact marker text, and says targeted-test criteria must still be reported met with evidence. A briefs.rs test asserts that wording.
criteria_check.evidence: The section now carries the paragraph and the LEFT_TO_ATHENA constant. Test producer_brief_tells_how_to_leave_a_criterion_to_athenas_checks asserts the marker, fmt, clippy, full or workspace cargo test, and the targeted-test sentence. It passes under cargo test -p athena-context briefs, as does the existing test requiring the criteria to be the last lines of the section.

criteria_check.criterion: CHANGELOG.md has an entry describing the change: self-check no longer sends back criteria left to Athena's checks.
criteria_check.evidence: A new first bullet under Unreleased / Changed in CHANGELOG.md describes it.

criteria_check.criterion: cargo fmt --check and cargo clippy --all-targets are clean, and cargo test passes for the workspace (Athena's recorded checks).
criteria_check.evidence: Ran cargo fmt --all --check (no output), cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings (finished clean), and cargo test --locked -q (all suites ok, no failures).

open_issues: A mixed criterion that names cargo test plus other content is eligible if the producer marks it. The verifier still judges it, as the plan accepted.
The self-check records left criteria in the verifier inputs only. The left-over list is not stored in the producer report record.
mistakes: My first draft of the content-criterion test marked it met, which unmet_criteria never returns. I changed it to unmet before running.
The first build warned that the left_criteria initial value was never read. I switched to a deferred initialization.
learnings: run.rs had no test module before. Existing pin tests live in run_pin_tests.rs.
The producer brief's section is checked by a test that expects the criteria to be its last lines, so new wording goes before the criteria list.
No test pins the producer JSON schema description text, so the outputs.rs doc comment was safe.
desires: Read access to a persisted large tool output, to find the failing test in a long cargo test log.
